result.brief: STRIKE 将视觉状态转移学习与稠密视频生成解耦，用图像转移模型预测未来场景状态，再以动态模型生成完整 rollout，为物理世界建模提供有效的中间表征。
result.reason: Learns visual state transitions as an intermediate representation for physical world modeling, with a transition model and dynamic rollout generator; directly relevant to world models and video representation.
